tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Desktop behind everything, boot splash, installer. Tinted faintly toward the god in each aspect. Ground for text, text-muted, accent-text, error.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Windows, panels, the pill, cards, dialogs. Ground for text, text-muted, accent-text, error.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows, tooltips, the cover of a media card. One step above surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: text fields, switch track, segmented track.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative lines and frames on surface and background: inactive window border, dividers, progress track.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: controls, secondary buttons, tooltips. 3.2:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Cream line work: wallpaper drawing, bracket frames, the edge of the selected theme card. Drawn at 1px, usually at reduced opacity.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer under dialogs, the session menu and the theme picker.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on background, surface and surface-raised (13.9:1 or more). Wordmark, slider thumb.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and resting icons on background, surface and surface-raised (6.2:1 or more).

tokens.name: text-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, line numbers, timestamps, the :: separator. 3.6:1 or more: never for text a person must read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The colour of the god of the moment: Strix red under Saturnus, the default, and one hue per aspect. Fills only: main action, selected segment, active workspace, active window border, running progress, cursor, the disc of the wallpaper. Not for text; use accent-text.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button under the pointer.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button while pressed.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet ground in the accent hue: hover of a danger button, selection in text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: The accent as text or icon on background, surface, surface-raised and accent-soft (5.2:1 or more): the list caret, the power icon, links.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent, accent-hover and accent-pressed (4.5:1 or more in every aspect): white on dark accents, near-black on light ones.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 2px, after a 2px gap in background. 4.0:1 or more on background, surface and surface-raised in every aspect.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text and the border of a field in error, on background, surface and surface-raised (6.3:1 or more). Always with words.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings as text or icon with words, on background and surface (7.7:1 or more). Never a filled box.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success as text or icon with words, on background and surface (7.8:1 or more).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information as text or icon with words, on background and surface (7.1:1 or more).

tokens.name: syntax-keyword
tokens.usage: Code: keywords and storage.

tokens.name: syntax-string
tokens.usage: Code: strings.

tokens.name: syntax-number
tokens.usage: Code: numbers and units.

tokens.name: syntax-function
tokens.usage: Code: function names, set bold.

tokens.name: syntax-type
tokens.usage: Code: types and modules.

tokens.name: syntax-constant
tokens.usage: Code: constants, attributes, macros.

tokens.name: syntax-comment
tokens.usage: Code: comments, set italic. 4.6:1 or more on background and surface.

tokens.name: syntax-operator
tokens.usage: Code: operators and punctuation.

tokens.name: chart-1

tokens.name: chart-2

tokens.name: chart-3

tokens.name: chart-4

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Charts: fifth series. Series differ in lightness, so they hold without colour.

families.serif: "IM Fell English", "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The wordmark on the lock screen, greeter and splash.

styles.name: emblem
styles.usage: Theme names on the picker card, the system name in About, the wordmark in system info. Names only, one or two words.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: The one large line of a panel: the date.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog titles, page titles in settings.

styles.name: aside
styles.usage: Italic asides: calendar month, panel headings, track titles, empty states, plate captions.

styles.name: motto
styles.usage: The motto and greetings. Lowercase, spaced, italic. One line, never a label.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: The stacked clock of the lock screen: hours over minutes, very light.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Installs every package the app needs.
styles.usage: Running text, list rows, field text, code and the terminal.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels and the left side of a label :: value pair. Semibold, sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Descriptions, the top bar, the dock, help text, segmented labels.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Badges, key hints, timestamps. Nothing smaller exists.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its value; padding inside the pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; gap from pill to panel.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of buttons and segments. Gap between tiled windows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of panels, cards and windows. Side inset of the top bar.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of dialogs; gap between groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Outer margin of full-screen layouts.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Left inset of the lock screen column.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox, list rows, segmented thumb, tooltip, calendar day.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented track.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Windows, panels, cards, dialogs, notifications.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large media: theme previews in the store and settings.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switch, radio, count badges, the active workspace, the search field.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Small floating parts: toolbar, tooltip.

tokens.name: shadow-window
tokens.usage: Tiled and floating windows.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, menus, notifications.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in background, then 2px of focus.

tokens.name: line-hair
tokens.usage: Every border and divider.

tokens.name: line-bold
tokens.usage: The filled part of a progress line and of a ring. Tracks stay at one pixel.

tokens.name: bar-height
tokens.usage: Height of the top bar.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and icon buttons inside panels.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, list rows.

tokens.name: dock-rest
tokens.usage: Height of the dock at rest: a thin tab on the bottom edge.

tokens.name: dock-height
tokens.usage: Height of the dock once the pointer reaches the bottom edge.

tokens.name: osd-height
tokens.usage: Height of the OSD.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback, menu hover.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, tooltips, small fades, border colour.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Switch, segmented thumb, tab change, dialogs, list items entering, window focus.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Panel growing out of the pill, carousel, windows opening and moving, workspace change, rolling numbers.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: Circular reveal of a new theme, unlocking, ring gauges filling.

tokens.name: dur-loop
tokens.usage: One pass of an indeterminate progress line.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between neighbours when a list enters.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things arriving: open, enter, hover.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Things leaving: close, dismiss.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things travelling: thumb, carousel, workspace change, reveal.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: A small overshoot: switch thumb, check mark, window pop.

tokens.name: dim-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls.

tokens.name: dim-inactive
tokens.usage: Inactive windows.

tokens.name: dim-wallpaper
tokens.usage: Wallpaper brightness under the lock screen and the theme picker.
